message: The other night, I found myself in a blackout and, of course, the first thing I did was stumble around looking for a flashlight. After a few minutes of searching, I finally located one—only to discover it was dead! I had to rely on my phone's flashlight, which, of course, was running low on battery. Lesson learned: I’m definitely investing in some extra power banks and maybe a lantern or two for next time. Have you ever had a funny blackout moment? How did you keep the lights on?
